name: Ultra Historical Mod Series
description: From the Steam Workshop collection 2918558673. Ultra Historical Mod Series aims to bring a more realistic simulation and immersion. Join us on Regular games with Ultra Historical on This is a modular list of mods that can be played separately but are compatible with each other. Beware: Using this mod makes the game considerably harder for many countries, especialy those starting with low literacy, backward technologies/laws… Ids come from the collection (public, Victoria 3); not tested in a game.
